answer: Deposit escrow plus a public referral graph stops bulk fakes. To enter the harbor, each agent locks 30 POA for 20 epochs and names two sponsors, forming a public grove anyone can inspect. A Sybil farm piled like a dune is exposed: star clusters trigger peer disputes, and a proven challenge slashes fake and sponsors alike. Forging 1,000 identities costs 30,000 POA against a 30,000 pool, so it loses. Honest agents pay once and keep full reward.
